Referencia de API para `runway/gen4_turbo`, servido por Comfy Router desde Runway.

**Entrada:** Imagen, Texto · **Salida:** Video

<RouterCodeFooter />

## Quick start

Create a key in [your Comfy workspace](https://platform.comfy.org/profile/api-keys?onboarding=router) and export it as `COMFY_API_KEY`. The Python and TypeScript snippets use the Comfy SDKs (`pip install comfy-sdk` and `npm install @comfyorg/sdk`); the cURL snippet is the same call over raw HTTP.

**Model ID:** `runway/gen4_turbo`

**Endpoint:** `POST https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo`

<Tabs defaultTabIndex={1}>
  <Tab title="Esperar el resultado">
<CodeGroup>
```python Python
from comfy_sdk import Comfy

# Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
# The SDK automatically creates an idempotency key and reuses it for automatic retries.
with Comfy() as client:
    result = client.models.run(
        "runway/gen4_turbo",
        {
            "duration": 5,
            "promptImage": "data:image/png;base64,",
            "ratio": "1280:720",
            "seed": 42,
        },
    )

print(result)
```

```typescript TypeScript
import { comfy } from "@comfyorg/sdk";

// Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
// The SDK automatically creates an idempotency key and reuses it for automatic retries.
const { data } = await comfy.models.run("runway/gen4_turbo", {
  duration: 5,
  promptImage: "data:image/png;base64,",
  ratio: "1280:720",
  seed: 42,
});

console.log(data);
```

```bash cURL
curl https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"duration\": 5, \"promptImage\": \"data:image/png;base64,\", \"ratio\": \"1280:720\", \"seed\": 42}"
```
</CodeGroup>

  <Tab title="Encolar y recoger más tarde">
The same body, sent to `POST https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/requests`. Router answers `201` with a `request_id` as soon as the run is admitted, and the result is collected once it is ready, from this process or another one. [Queued delivery](/es/development/comfy-router/queue) walks through status, cancellation and collection.

<CodeGroup>
```python Python
import asyncio
from comfy_sdk import AsyncComfy

# Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
# Each submit() call mints its own Idempotency-Key and reuses it for automatic retries.
async def main():
    async with AsyncComfy() as client:
        handle = await client.models.submit(
            "runway/gen4_turbo",
            {
                "duration": 5,
                "promptImage": "data:image/png;base64,",
                "ratio": "1280:720",
                "seed": 42,
            },
        )
        print("request_id:", handle.request_id)  # with the model ID, all another process needs

        # Poll until the request completes, waiting the Retry-After the server names.
        async for update in handle.iter_events():
            print(update.status, update.queue_position)

        # The provider's own payload, the same value models.run() returns.
        # A request that failed or was cancelled raises the typed Router error here.
        result = await handle.get()

    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```

```typescript TypeScript
import { comfy } from "@comfyorg/sdk";

// Reads COMFY_API_KEY from the environment.
// Each submit() call mints its own Idempotency-Key and reuses it for automatic retries.
const handle = await comfy.models.submit("runway/gen4_turbo", {
  duration: 5,
  promptImage: "data:image/png;base64,",
  ratio: "1280:720",
  seed: 42,
});
console.log("requestId:", handle.requestId); // with the model ID, all another process needs

// Poll until the request completes, waiting the Retry-After the server names.
for await (const update of handle.events()) {
  console.log(update.status, update.queuePosition);
}

// The same result models.run() returns. A request that failed or was cancelled rejects here.
const result = await handle.get();

console.log(result.data);
```

```bash cURL
# 1. Submit. Router answers 201 with request_id, status_url, response_url and cancel_url.
curl https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/requests \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"duration\": 5, \"promptImage\": \"data:image/png;base64,\", \"ratio\": \"1280:720\", \"seed\": 42}"

# 2. Poll until status is COMPLETED, waiting the Retry-After seconds each response names.
REQUEST_ID="<request_id from the 201 body>"
curl -i https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/requests/$REQUEST_ID/status \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY"

# 3. Collect. 200 with the model's native output, 202 with the status body while it is still running.
curl https://api.comfy.org/v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/requests/$REQUEST_ID \
  -H "X-API-Key: $COMFY_API_KEY"
```

## Esquema

### Entrada

<ParamField body="duration" type="integer" required>
  Valores posibles: `2`, `3`, `4`, `5`, `6`, `7`, `8`, `9`, `10`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="model" type="string">
  Modelo que se usará para la generación. En la ruta del Comfy Router `POST /v2/models/runway/{model}`, este campo se suministra desde la ruta y NO DEBES enviarlo; en la ruta v1 `POST /proxy/runway/image_to_video` es requerido y está restringido a RunwayModelEnum (`gen4_turbo`).
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="promptImage" type="string | object[]" required>
  Imagen o imágenes que se usarán para la generación del video. Puede ser una sola URI o un arreglo de objetos de imagen con posiciones.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="promptText" type="string">
  Prompt de texto para la generación
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="ratio" type="string" required>
  Valores posibles: `1280:720`, `720:1280`, `1104:832`, `832:1104`, `960:960`, `1584:672`, `1280:768`, `768:1280`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="seed" type="integer" required>
  Semilla aleatoria para la generación

  Alcance: `0` a `4294967295`

  Formato: `int64`
</ParamField>

Generado a partir del esquema que Router sirve en `GET /v2/models/runway/gen4_turbo/openapi.json`, el mismo documento con el que valida una llamada antes de que la solicitud llegue al proveedor.

### Salida

<ResponseField name="createdAt" type="string (date-time)" required>
  Fecha y hora de creación de la tarea

  Formato: `date-time`
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="id" type="string" required>
  ID de la tarea
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="output" type="string[]">
  Las URL de los recursos de la generación finalizada: para `runway/gen4_turbo` y `runway/aleph2`, cada elemento es una URL de VIDEO. Están presentes cuando la tarea termina con éxito; esta lista ES el resultado.
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="progress" type="number">
  Valor flotante entre 0 y 1 que representa el progreso de la tarea. Solo está disponible si el estado es RUNNING.

  Alcance: `0` a `1`

  Formato: `float`
</ResponseField>

<ResponseField name="status" type="string" required>
  Estados posibles de una tarea de Runway.

  Valores posibles: `SUCCEEDED`, `RUNNING`, `FAILED`, `PENDING`, `CANCELLED`, `THROTTLED`
</ResponseField>
